title: hubSpecDocument
responsibility: Gives the ask cards under Hub Home a way to load the signed-in owner's attached documents.

inputs.name: provideHubSpecDocuments.api
inputs.description: The Hub browser API of the signed-in owner, used to request documents.

outputs.name: provideHubSpecDocuments
outputs.description: Sets the document loader in the current Svelte component context.

outputs.name: hubSpecDocuments
outputs.description: The loader set by an ancestor; it requests a document by attachment id.

errors.name: BrowserApiRequestError
errors.description: The returned loader rejects when the Hub request fails, such as for a document not yet uploaded.
